'''11,947 BBY''' or '''11,947<ref name="EGW" /> Before the Battle of Yavin''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that fell in the period of [[Time/Legends|time]] known as the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="Era" /> By that year, fanatic members of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Pius Dea]] faith effectively controlled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In 11,947 BBY, the Pius Dea adherent [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]] stepped down as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic after his forty-year term, allowing his [[Gender/Legends|son]] [[Contispex II]] to take up the position instead and thus giving rise to the [[Contispex dynasty]] of Chancellors.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
11,947 BBY was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGW" />
